stage: One source-measured worker/operator/control proposal before authoring; needs Lead acceptance

lead_decision.stage: Lead accepted layout basis for actual anatomy/control fitting and coordinated authoring; not passed reach, clearance, human appearance or runtime acceptance
lead_decision.hardware: Recessed manual paddles and fixed-frame linkage accepted as scoped revision within original footprint. Both corresponding end pins must have explicit release/engagement states, including hand transfer without accidental relocking.
lead_decision.body: Actual worker uses genuine palm/finger edge grips, steps and hips/knees. The 715mm reach is not passed; no arm stretching or teleport. Check occupied bale, gloves, helmet, torso, feet, frame, truck and neighboring geometry through full motion.
lead_decision.timing: Eight seconds each direction is a fitting reference, not final duration. No forced old 1.5-second rigid mechanism action.
lead_decision.ownership: Receiving reserves one actual worker and module through approach, operation, latch and hands-clear. Pause freezes both. Animation does not grant stock or completion. No motion without operator contact/control; interruption cannot fabricate a latch.
lead_decision.preserved: Existing support, padding, footprint, quantities, upper-empty and closed-before-upper-loading rules, M05-only insert, worker identity, original timber pickup bend and v02 source history.
lead_decision.next: Artist supplies fitted coordinated worker/mechanism clips and exported contract, plus complete normal-speed opening and closing video showing hands and feet for human approval; report a concrete fitting blocker if necessary.
